Name: HyperDeck [MikanseiLaboratory]
Description: Control any number of named HyperDeck decks from Stream Deck.

dev.mikanseilaboratory.bmd.hyperdeck.pla.Name: Play
dev.mikanseilaboratory.bmd.hyperdeck.pla.Tooltip: Play or stop. Lights while playing.

dev.mikanseilaboratory.bmd.hyperdeck.rec.Name: Record
dev.mikanseilaboratory.bmd.hyperdeck.rec.Tooltip: Record or stop. Hold to spill.

dev.mikanseilaboratory.bmd.hyperdeck.cli.Name: Clip
dev.mikanseilaboratory.bmd.hyperdeck.cli.Tooltip: Go to a clip. Hold to play it.

dev.mikanseilaboratory.bmd.hyperdeck.pla.Name: Play Range
dev.mikanseilaboratory.bmd.hyperdeck.pla.Tooltip: Set a play range. Hold to clear it.

dev.mikanseilaboratory.bmd.hyperdeck.nas.Name: NAS
dev.mikanseilaboratory.bmd.hyperdeck.nas.Tooltip: Add, remove, select, or deselect a NAS.

dev.mikanseilaboratory.bmd.hyperdeck.dro.Name: Dropped Frames
dev.mikanseilaboratory.bmd.hyperdeck.dro.Tooltip: Lights when frames have been dropped.

dev.mikanseilaboratory.bmd.hyperdeck.rem.Name: Remaining
dev.mikanseilaboratory.bmd.hyperdeck.rem.Tooltip: Lights when remaining record time is low.

dev.mikanseilaboratory.bmd.hyperdeck.cli.Name: Clip Step
dev.mikanseilaboratory.bmd.hyperdeck.cli.Tooltip: Step to the next or previous clip.

dev.mikanseilaboratory.bmd.hyperdeck.got.Name: Go To
dev.mikanseilaboratory.bmd.hyperdeck.got.Tooltip: Go to a timeline, clip, or timecode.

dev.mikanseilaboratory.bmd.hyperdeck.rec.Name: Record Named
dev.mikanseilaboratory.bmd.hyperdeck.rec.Tooltip: Start a recording with a name.

dev.mikanseilaboratory.bmd.hyperdeck.cli.Name: Clips Add
dev.mikanseilaboratory.bmd.hyperdeck.cli.Tooltip: Add a clip to the timeline.

dev.mikanseilaboratory.bmd.hyperdeck.cli.Name: Clips Remove
dev.mikanseilaboratory.bmd.hyperdeck.cli.Tooltip: Remove a clip from the timeline.

dev.mikanseilaboratory.bmd.hyperdeck.sta.Name: Status
dev.mikanseilaboratory.bmd.hyperdeck.sta.Tooltip: Show one transport or device field.

dev.mikanseilaboratory.bmd.hyperdeck.jog.Name: Jog
dev.mikanseilaboratory.bmd.hyperdeck.jog.Tooltip: Jog by frames. Press to stop.

dev.mikanseilaboratory.bmd.hyperdeck.pla.Name: Play Speed
dev.mikanseilaboratory.bmd.hyperdeck.pla.Tooltip: Change play speed. Press to play or stop.

dev.mikanseilaboratory.bmd.hyperdeck.pos.Name: Position
dev.mikanseilaboratory.bmd.hyperdeck.pos.Tooltip: Move the timeline. Press to stop.

dev.mikanseilaboratory.bmd.hyperdeck.cli.Name: Clip List
dev.mikanseilaboratory.bmd.hyperdeck.cli.Tooltip: Move through the clip list. Press to play. Touch to stop.

dev.mikanseilaboratory.bmd.hyperdeck.raw.Name: Raw Dial
dev.mikanseilaboratory.bmd.hyperdeck.raw.Tooltip: Send a raw command for each dial gesture.
